tap into resources: The small village learned to tap into resources such as hot springs and local tea to attract tourists.
這個小村莊學會利用溫泉和當地茶葉等資源來吸引觀光客。
tap the market: The company hopes to tap the market of young gamers by selling cheaper headphones online.
這家公司希望藉由在網路上販售較便宜的耳機來開拓年輕玩家的市場。
tap one's potential: A good coach can help every player tap his potential and play better than he ever thought possible.
好的教練能幫助每位球員發揮潛力，打出比他想像中更好的表現。
tap someone for a job: The manager decided to tap someone for a job from inside the company rather than hire an outsider.
經理決定從公司內部相中某人擔任這份職務，而不是聘請外人。
tap a phone: In the spy movie, the police had to get permission from a judge before they could tap a phone.
在那部間諜電影裡，警方必須先取得法官許可才能竊聽電話。
tap the keyboard: Late at night, I could hear my sister tap the keyboard as she rushed to finish her history report.
深夜時，我聽得到姊姊敲鍵盤的聲音，她正趕著完成歷史報告。
on tap: The hotel has hot water on tap all day, and guests can also get free tea in the lobby.
這間飯店全天隨時供應熱水，房客也可以在大廳免費取用茶飲。
target young people: Many fast-food ads target young people by using popular singers and funny short videos online.
許多速食廣告以年輕人為目標，在網路上使用當紅歌手和有趣的短影片。
be targeted by criticism: After the referee made several bad calls, he began to be targeted by criticism from fans of both teams.
裁判做出幾次錯誤判決後，他開始成為雙方球迷批評的目標。
target a market: Before you start a business, you should clearly target a market and learn what those customers really want.
在創業之前，你應該清楚鎖定一個市場，並了解那些顧客真正想要什麼。
target the wrong audience: The toy company lost money because its ads seemed to target the wrong audience: old people instead of children.
那家玩具公司賠了錢，因為它的廣告似乎鎖定了錯誤的對象：老年人而不是兒童。
targeted advertising: After I searched for running shoes online, targeted advertising for sports brands appeared on every website I visited.
我在網路上搜尋跑鞋之後，我造訪的每個網站上都出現了運動品牌的精準廣告。
taste success: After years of failing the audition, the young singer finally got to taste success when her first song became a hit.
那位年輕歌手多年來試鏡失敗，終於在第一首歌爆紅時嘗到成功的滋味。
taste defeat: Our basketball team had won twenty games in a row, so it was hard for us to taste defeat in the final.
我們籃球隊已經連贏二十場，所以在決賽中嘗到失敗對我們來說很難受。
taste freedom: After the long exam week, students rushed out of school to taste freedom at the night market.
漫長的考試週結束後，學生們衝出校門，到夜市去體驗自由的滋味。
taste the soup: Before serving dinner, Grandma always asks me to taste the soup and tell her if it needs more salt.
晚餐上桌前，奶奶總是叫我嚐湯，告訴她要不要再加點鹽。
get a taste of: Working part-time at a café helped me get a taste of what real working life is like.
在咖啡廳打工讓我體會到真正的職場生活是什麼樣子。
taste of one's own medicine: The bully always laughed at others, so when everyone laughed at him, he got a taste of his own medicine.
那個惡霸總是嘲笑別人，所以當大家都嘲笑他時，他算是被以其人之道還治其身了。
to taste: Boil the noodles for three minutes, then add soy sauce and pepper to taste before serving them hot.
麵條煮三分鐘，然後依個人口味加入醬油和胡椒，趁熱上桌。
tax one's patience: The noisy children on the train began to tax my patience after two hours of screaming and kicking seats.
火車上吵鬧的孩子尖叫、踢椅子了兩個小時，開始考驗我的耐心。
tax one's strength: Climbing Jade Mountain in one day can tax your strength, so you should train for several weeks first.
一天之內攀登玉山會大量消耗你的體力，所以你應該先訓練幾個星期。
tax the system: Thousands of students logging in at the same time to check exam results can tax the system and make it crash.
數千名學生同時登入查詢考試成績，可能會使系統負擔過重而當機。
tax income: Most countries tax income from salaries, and the money is used to pay for roads, schools, and hospitals.
大多數國家都對薪資收入課稅，這些錢用來支付道路、學校和醫院的費用。
heavily taxed: Cigarettes are heavily taxed in many countries because governments want to stop people from smoking.
香菸在許多國家稅負沉重，因為政府希望讓人們不再吸菸。
taxing work: Moving heavy boxes in the hot sun all day is taxing work, so the workers need plenty of water and rest.
整天在大太陽下搬運重箱子是很費力的工作，所以工人需要充足的水和休息。
tear down a building: The city plans to tear down a building that is too old and dangerous and build a park in its place.
市政府計畫拆除一棟太老舊危險的建築，並在原址興建公園。
tear apart the family: The long fight over Grandpa's land began to tear apart the family, and the brothers stopped speaking to each other.
為了爺爺的土地而起的長期爭執開始拆散這個家庭，兄弟們彼此不再說話。
tear up a contract: When the singer found out about the unfair terms, she wanted to tear up a contract she had signed years before.
那位歌手發現不公平的條款後，想撕毀她多年前簽下的合約。
tear into someone: The coach was so angry about the lazy defense that he started to tear into someone the moment the game ended.
教練對懶散的防守非常生氣，比賽一結束他就開始痛批某人。
tear oneself away: The video game was so exciting that Jack could hardly tear himself away from the screen to eat dinner.
那款電玩太刺激了，傑克盯著螢幕依依不捨，幾乎無法離開去吃晚餐。
tear through the city: The strong typhoon will tear through the city tonight, so all schools and offices will be closed tomorrow.
強烈颱風今晚將席捲城市，所以明天所有學校和辦公室都會停班停課。
